abstract: There are numerous common and rare macroscopic fat-containing masses found in the abdomen and pelvis. These include benign masses, such as lipoleiomyoma, ovarian teratoma, mesenteric teratoma, and lipoma, as well as malignant masses, including liposarcoma and malignant transformation of benign entities. Any mass may become symptomatic due to the development of a complication which may range from ovarian torsion to intussusception to hemorrhage. Imaging plays a vital role in diagnosis and treatment planning when confronted with a symptomatic fat-containing mass.
abstract_ja: 腹部および骨盤内には、脂肪を含む多数の一般的および稀な巨視的腫瘤が見られる。良性のものとして脂肪平滑筋腫、卵巣奇形腫、腸間膜奇形腫、脂肪腫があり、悪性のものとして脂肪肉腫や良性病変の悪性転化が含まれる。いずれの腫瘤も、卵巣捻転から腸重積、出血に至るまでの合併症を生じると症状を呈しうる。症状を呈する脂肪含有腫瘤に直面した際、診断および治療計画において画像診断は重要な役割を果たす。
